messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] R Group in Spring 2022
messages.body_plain:
Some bad news and some good news.

The bad news is that with a new course prep this semester, I just don't really have time to organize the R group.  So I'm looking for somebody to step up and set the schedule.  I'll still participate, but I just don't have the bandwidth this semester.

Are you willing to step up?

Thanks,

    --Russell

P.S.  The good news is that I'm developing resources in the course that we can use in future R group sessions.

    --R
